versions.localizedDescription:
Welcome! This is the first versioned release of everything thats been on our nightly since 1.3.0 in may, future releases will be tagged and published this way going forward:

streaming
- pauses in the background instead of disconnecting, and reconnects on its own after a drop or a lock (#66, #80, #109)
- pip recovers when its display layer fails, thanks @alantangok (#108)
- audio buffer and race fixes, memcpy clamp from #70 thanks @2extndd (#85, #110)
- connecting no longer kills music thats playing, it mixes instead, plus a status overlay (#86)

input
- touchpad style cursor and crisp zoom, thanks @rebelancap (#78)
- zoom viewport stays above the keyboard, thanks @alantangok (#107)
- direct mode and keyboard fixes (#81, #87)
- external pointer fixes and left alt no longer sent as win, thanks @jobsgonnawork (#91)
- option key as command setting (#94)

app
- login fixes, saved login readable after first unlock (#89, #111)
- fixes from live testing: screen stays awake while streaming, says when the session expired or the host didnt approve, names the host its reconnecting to, cursor and zoom fixes (#105)
- reconnect memory leak and version string fixes from #70, thanks @2extndd (#84)
- error reporting and logging (#77, #90)
- safety fixes and cleanups (#82, #83)
- every nightly has its own build number now so altstore shows it as an update (#112, #95 )

Expect a 2.0 release in the coming weeks with lots more improvements! Thank you for your support!


---
